en.summary: The main fix removes a false-completion path that could deadlock Gemmini when zero-write traffic overlapped bias-load DMA responses; the same commit also widens several occupancy/count fields.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes a deadlock and undersized ports.
The patch changes central `Scratchpad` completion logic plus several DUT-side width calculations.
The modified behavior is about hardware progress/completion semantics, not tooling or tests.
disqualifiers: There are minor import and formatting cleanups in the same commit.
evidence: In `src/main/scala/gemmini/Scratchpad.scala`, `spad_last` stops OR-ing in `spad_zerowrite_last` and now tracks only the scratchpad DMA-read completion term.
`src/main/scala/gemmini/ROB.scala`, `LoopConv.scala`, and `LoopMatmul.scala` widen utilization/count signals from `log2Up(x)` to `log2Up(x+1)`, matching the commit message about too-small ports.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A DMA or scratchpad read path must not let an unrelated zero-fill response satisfy the completion condition for an in-flight read transaction. If a shared “last beat” signal treats zero-write completion as equivalent to DMA-read completion, overlapping zero-fill and bias-load traffic can mark the read finished too early and wedge downstream progress. The same commit also fixes width overflows in occupancy counters, but the deadlock bug is the clearest reinjection target.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: completion arbitration between zero-fill and DMA-read response streams
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A zero-write or clear operation completes in the same window that a scratchpad or bias-load DMA read is active.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Feed zero-write completion back into the scratchpad DMA-read “last beat” condition.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: OR unrelated response source into completion-last predicate
portability_notes: This applies wherever zero-fill engines and DMA readers share completion bookkeeping, ROB progress, or retirement logic.
Keep the actual data routing intact; only corrupt the condition that declares the DMA read finished.
The secondary width fixes can be injected separately if you want full-capacity overflow bugs, but they are not required to reproduce the deadlock.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that generates the “last beat” or “DMA read complete” pulse for scratchpad or bias-load reads.
Identify any nearby zero-write, zero-fill, or clear-engine response channel.
Reintroduce that zero-write response as an alternative source of the read-complete pulse for non-accumulator scratchpad traffic.
Leave the rest of the response routing and ROB bookkeeping unchanged so the false completion causes a hang or deadlock.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Gemmini scratchpad `spad_last` completion logic, with secondary width fixes in zero-writer and loop/ROB counters
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The primary fix removes zero-writer completion from `spad_last`, so scratchpad DMA-read completion only tracks the `mvin_scale` path. The same commit also widens several count/utilization fields from `log2Up(x)` to `log2Up(x+1)`.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In `src/main/scala/gemmini/Scratchpad.scala`, `spad_last` changed from `spad_dmaread_last || spad_zerowrite_last` to only the DMA-read term; supporting width fixes appear in `ZeroWriter.scala`, `ROB.scala`, `LoopConv.scala`, and `LoopMatmul.scala`.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Overlapping zero-write and bias-load activity can falsely signal read completion, wedge ROB progress, and freeze the accelerator; separate counter overflows may also reappear at full utilization.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message explicitly names a deadlock caused by simultaneous bias load and zero write.
The Scratchpad diff removes only the zero-write term from the read-completion predicate, making the deadlock reinjection target concrete.
The widened width fields in other files support the “ports too small” part of the message but are secondary to the deadlock fix.
notes: For a single portable injection target, focus on the `Scratchpad.scala` completion bug and treat the width fixes as auxiliary evidence.
If you revert the width fixes as well, you may introduce additional overflow failures beyond the original deadlock scenario.

zh.summary: 主要修复点是移除了一个错误的完成路径：当 zero-write 与 bias-load DMA 响应重叠时，该路径会让 Gemmini 误判完成并死锁；同一提交还扩宽了若干占用率/计数字段。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复了死锁以及位宽过小的问题。
补丁修改了核心 `Scratchpad` 完成逻辑，并扩宽了多个 DUT 侧计数/占用位宽。
被修改的是硬件进度与完成语义，而不是工具或测试。
disqualifiers: 同一提交中还有少量 import 和格式清理。
evidence: 在 `src/main/scala/gemmini/Scratchpad.scala` 中，`spad_last` 不再把 `spad_zerowrite_last` OR 进去，而只跟踪 scratchpad DMA 读完成条件。
`src/main/scala/gemmini/ZeroWriter.scala` 把 `cols` 的位宽从 `log2Up(max_cols)` 扩为 `log2Up(max_cols+1)`。
`src/main/scala/gemmini/ROB.scala`、`LoopConv.scala` 和 `LoopMatmul.scala` 把占用率/计数字段从 `log2Up(x)` 扩为 `log2Up(x+1)`，与提交信息中的“ports too small”一致。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: DMA 或 scratchpad 读路径绝不能把无关的 zero-fill 响应当作正在进行的读事务的完成条件。如果共享的“最后一个 beat”信号把 zero-write 完成与 DMA 读完成等同起来，那么当 zero-fill 与 bias-load 并发时，系统就可能过早宣布读已结束，从而卡死后续进度。该提交还修复了若干占用计数器的位宽溢出问题，但最清晰的回注目标仍然是死锁缺陷。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: zero-fill 与 DMA-read 响应流之间的完成仲裁
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: zero-write 或 clear 操作完成的同时，scratchpad 或 bias-load DMA 读仍在进行。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 zero-write 的完成重新并入 scratchpad DMA-read 的“最后一个 beat”条件。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 把无关响应源 OR 进完成判定谓词
portability_notes: 适用于 zero-fill 引擎与 DMA 读共享完成计账、ROB 进度或退休逻辑的实现。
保持真实数据路由不变，只破坏“何时认为 DMA 读完成”的条件。
同一提交中的位宽修复可以单独作为容量溢出类缺陷处理，但不是重现死锁所必需。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到为 scratchpad 或 bias-load 读生成“最后一个 beat”或“DMA 读完成”脉冲的逻辑。
定位附近的 zero-write、zero-fill 或 clear-engine 响应通道。
把该 zero-write 响应重新接入非 accumulator scratchpad 读的完成脉冲。
保持其他响应路由与 ROB 计账不变，使错误完成最终表现为卡住或死锁。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Gemmini 中的 scratchpad `spad_last` 完成逻辑，以及 zero-writer/loop/ROB 的辅助位宽修复
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 主要修复是把 zero-writer 完成从 `spad_last` 中移除，使 scratchpad DMA 读完成只跟踪 `mvin_scale` 路径。同一提交还把若干计数/占用位宽从 `log2Up(x)` 扩成 `log2Up(x+1)`。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 `src/main/scala/gemmini/Scratchpad.scala` 中，`spad_last` 从 `spad_dmaread_last || spad_zerowrite_last` 改为只保留 DMA-read 项；配套的位宽修复位于 `ZeroWriter.scala`、`ROB.scala`、`LoopConv.scala` 与 `LoopMatmul.scala`。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当 zero-write 与 bias-load 并发时，系统可能错误宣布读完成，导致 ROB 进度卡住并冻结加速器；满负载下也可能重新出现独立的计数器溢出。
evidence_for_injection: 提交信息明确指出死锁是由 bias load 与 zero write 同时发生导致的。
Scratchpad 的补丁只移除了读完成判定中的 zero-write 分支，因此回注目标很具体。
其他文件中的位宽扩展支持了“ports too small”这部分说明，但它们是次要问题。
notes: 若只需要一个可移植的注入目标，应聚焦 `Scratchpad.scala` 中的完成判定缺陷，把位宽修复视为辅助证据。
如果连同位宽修复一并回退，可能会引入超出原始死锁场景之外的额外溢出失败。
